_note: All businesses, names, prices and policies are fictional, written for this dataset.

train.card:
Business: Libas Lawn House (online women's clothing, Lahore)
- Products: unstitched 3-piece lawn suits Rs 3,450-6,900; stitched suits +Rs 1,200, ready in 7 working days.
- Sizes for stitched: S, M, L, XL (size chart on product page). Custom measurements not available.
- Delivery: Lahore 2-3 working days, rest of Pakistan 3-5 working days. Delivery charge Rs 250, free above Rs 7,000.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, bank transfer.
- Exchange: within 7 days of delivery, unused with tags, for unstitched suits only. Stitched suits cannot be exchanged except for a stitching fault.
- Refund: only if the item is damaged or wrong; report within 48 hours with photos. Refund by bank transfer in 5-7 working days.
- Sale items cannot be exchanged or refunded.
- Hours: Mon-Sat 10am-7pm.

Business: Karachi Kicks (online shoe store, Karachi)
- Men's and women's sneakers, sandals and khussa. Prices Rs 2,200-9,500.
- Sizes: EU 36-46. If between sizes, choose the larger size.
- Delivery: Karachi next working day if ordered before 2pm; other cities 3-4 working days. Flat delivery charge Rs 200.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery or card on website. COD orders above Rs 8,000 need advance payment of Rs 1,000.
- Size exchange: within 10 days, shoes unworn in original box. Customer pays Rs 200 return shipping for size exchange.
- Refund: only for manufacturing defects reported within 14 days, as store credit or bank transfer.
- Order cancellation possible until the order is dispatched.

Business: Bismillah Biryani & BBQ (food delivery, Karachi - Gulshan, Johar, PECHS)
- Menu: chicken biryani Rs 450 single / Rs 1,600 family; beef biryani Rs 550 / Rs 1,900; BBQ platter Rs 2,400; raita Rs 80.
- Open daily 12pm-12am. Last order 11:30pm.
- Delivery time 40-60 minutes. Delivery charge Rs 100; free on orders above Rs 2,000.
- Delivery only in Gulshan, Johar and PECHS.
- Payment: cash on delivery or JazzCash. No cards at the door.
- Wrong or missing item: report within 1 hour of delivery; we resend the item free.
- Bulk orders (above 20 people) need 24 hours notice.

Business: Mobile Zone (online phone accessories, Rawalpindi)
- Products: chargers, cables, earbuds, power banks, phone covers. No mobile phones sold.
- Warranty: earbuds and power banks 6 months checking warranty; cables and covers no warranty.
- Warranty claim: send the item with the invoice; replacement in 7-10 working days if the fault is confirmed. Physical or water damage is not covered.
- Delivery all over Pakistan 2-5 working days, Rs 199. Free above Rs 3,000.
- Payment: COD, Easypaisa, card.
- Returns: within 3 days of delivery, only if sealed and unopened.
- Hours: Mon-Sat 11am-8pm.

Business: Glow Naturals (online skincare, Islamabad)
- Products: face wash Rs 950, vitamin C serum Rs 2,250, sunblock SPF 50 Rs 1,650, hair oil Rs 1,100.
- All products are for external use. We do not give medical advice; for skin conditions please see a dermatologist.
- Delivery 3-5 working days nationwide, Rs 220. Free above Rs 4,000.
- Payment: COD, bank transfer, JazzCash.
- Opened products cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.
- Damaged or leaking product: send a photo within 24 hours of delivery and we will replace it.
- Expiry is at least 12 months from the delivery date.

Business: Kids Corner Toys (online toy shop, Lahore)
- Toys for ages 1-12, prices Rs 600-15,000. Age range is written on each product page.
- Delivery: Lahore 1-2 days, other cities 3-5 days. Rs 200 delivery, free above Rs 5,000.
- Gift wrapping Rs 150 per item; a gift card message can be added at checkout.
- Payment: COD and card.
- Returns: within 7 days if unopened. Opened toys are returned only if faulty.
- Batteries are not included unless stated on the product page.
- Customer support on WhatsApp 10am-6pm, Mon-Sat.

Business: Ghar Decor (furniture and decor, Lahore and Islamabad)
- Delivery: Lahore and Islamabad only, 7-14 working days for furniture, 3-5 days for decor items.
- Delivery charge: furniture Rs 2,500, decor Rs 300.
- Free assembly for beds, wardrobes and dining tables in Lahore and Islamabad.
- Payment: 50% advance for furniture, remaining on delivery. Decor items: COD allowed.
- Custom size/color furniture: not available.
- Damage during delivery: check at the door and report before signing; report later is not accepted.
- Furniture orders can be cancelled within 24 hours of payment for a full refund; after that 20% cancellation charge.

Business: Fresh Basket (grocery delivery, Islamabad and Rawalpindi)
- Delivery slots: 10am-1pm, 2pm-5pm, 6pm-9pm. Same-day slot if ordered 3 hours before the slot.
- Minimum order Rs 1,500. Delivery Rs 150, free above Rs 5,000.
- Fruits and vegetables are weighed; final bill can differ by up to 10%.
- Payment: COD, card on delivery, Easypaisa.
- Missing or bad-quality items: report within 6 hours with a photo; refund to Fresh Basket wallet.
- Out-of-stock items are removed from the order and not charged.
- Service area: Islamabad sectors and Rawalpindi Saddar, Bahria Town, DHA.

Business: TezRaftar Courier (parcel delivery, all Pakistan)
- Rates within city Rs 180 up to 1 kg; intercity Rs 280 up to 1 kg; Rs 120 per extra kg.
- Delivery time: within city 1 day, intercity 2-4 working days. No delivery on Sundays.
- Tracking: customers can track with the CN number on our website.
- Prohibited items: cash, jewelry, liquids, medicines, weapons.
- Lost parcel: claim within 15 days of booking; compensation up to Rs 5,000 or declared value, whichever is lower, only if the parcel was insured (2% of declared value).
- Pickup from home: Rs 100 extra in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad.

Business: Kitaab Ghar (online bookstore, Lahore)
- Urdu and English books: novels, poetry, Islamic books, school books (Punjab board).
- Delivery all over Pakistan 3-6 working days, Rs 180. Free above Rs 3,000.
- Pre-order books arrive in 3-4 weeks; pre-orders need full advance payment.
- Payment: COD (not for pre-orders), bank transfer, JazzCash.
- Returns: only for misprinted or damaged books, within 5 days, with photos.
- Used books are sold as-is, no returns.
- Bulk school orders (50+ books): 10% discount.

Kaarobar: Glam Studio Salon (ladies salon, DHA Karachi)
- Services: haircut Rs 2,500, facial Rs 3,500 se shuru, party makeup Rs 8,000, bridal makeup Rs 45,000 se shuru.
- Appointment WhatsApp par book hoti hai. Bridal booking ke liye Rs 10,000 advance zaroori hai.
- Timings: Tuesday se Sunday 11am-8pm. Monday off.
- 15 minute se zyada late aane par appointment cancel ho sakti hai.
- Appointment cancel/reschedule 24 ghante pehle free hai. Bridal advance non-refundable hai magar date ek dafa change ho sakti hai.
- Home service available nahi hai.
- Payment: cash, card, bank transfer.

Business: FitZone Gym (Gulberg, Lahore)
- Membership: monthly Rs 8,000, quarterly Rs 21,000, yearly Rs 72,000. One-time admission fee Rs 5,000.
- Timings: men 6am-3pm and 9pm-12am, women 3pm-9pm. Friday closed.
- Personal trainer: Rs 15,000 per month extra.
- Membership freeze: allowed once a year for up to 30 days, only on quarterly and yearly plans.
- Fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.
- Free trial: one day, with CNIC.
- Lockers available; bring your own lock.

Business: Sweet Tooth Bakery (custom cakes, Islamabad)
- Cakes: 2 lb Rs 3,200, 3 lb Rs 4,600, 4 lb Rs 6,000. Fondant/theme cakes start at Rs 7,500.
- Order at least 48 hours in advance; theme cakes 4 days in advance.
- 50% advance to confirm order, rest on pickup/delivery.
- Delivery in Islamabad only, Rs 400. Pickup from F-10 branch.
- Eggless cakes available on request; we are not a nut-free kitchen.
- Cancellations 24 hours before delivery: advance refunded. After that the advance is not refunded.
- Name/message on cake is free.

Business: TechFix Laptop Repair (Hafeez Centre, Lahore)
- Diagnosis fee Rs 1,000, adjusted in the repair bill if repair is done.
- Common repairs: screen replacement Rs 9,000-25,000 depending on model; keyboard Rs 3,500-7,000; battery Rs 6,000-12,000; Windows install Rs 1,500.
- Repair time 2-5 working days after customer approves the quote.
- Warranty on repairs: 30 days on the replaced part only.
- Data backup is the customer's responsibility; data backup service Rs 1,500.
- Laptops not collected within 60 days are not our responsibility.
- Courier service for other cities: customer pays both-way courier.

valid.card:
Business: Paws & Claws (online pet supplies, Karachi)
- Cat food 1.2 kg Rs 2,100, dog food 3 kg Rs 4,800, cat litter 10 L Rs 1,350.
- Delivery Karachi 1-2 days, other cities 3-5 days. Rs 250, free above Rs 6,000.
- Payment: COD, card, Easypaisa.
- Food items cannot be returned once opened.
- Wrong item delivered: exchange free within 3 days.
- We do not give veterinary advice; please consult a vet.

Business: Safar Tours (group trips from Lahore)
- Trips: Naran 5 days Rs 38,000 per person; Hunza 7 days Rs 62,000; Murree 2 days Rs 14,000.
- Price includes transport, hotel (shared rooms of 3-4) and breakfast + dinner.
- Booking: 30% advance, rest 7 days before departure.
- Cancellation: more than 15 days before departure 80% refund; 7-15 days 50%; less than 7 days no refund.
- Children under 5 travel free without a seat.
- Trips can be cancelled by us due to weather; then full refund or next trip.

eval.card:
Business: Shifa Pharmacy Online (medicine delivery, Lahore)
- Prescription medicines need a clear photo of a valid prescription before dispatch.
- We do not suggest medicines or doses; please ask your doctor.
- Delivery in Lahore within 24 hours, Rs 150. Free above Rs 3,000.
- Payment: COD and card.
- Medicines cannot be returned once delivered, except wrong or damaged items reported within 24 hours.
- Cold-chain items (insulin, vaccines) are delivered in an ice box; same-day delivery only.
- Hours: daily 9am-11pm.

Kaarobar: Ilm Academy (online tuition, Zoom par)
- Classes: Matric aur FSc ke liye Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English.
- Fee: ek subject Rs 4,000 mahana, teen ya zyada subjects Rs 10,000 mahana.
- Classes Monday se Friday shaam 5 baje se 9 baje tak.
- Pehli class free demo hai.
- Fee har mahine ki 10 tareekh tak advance deni hoti hai. Fee wapis nahi hoti.
- Har class ki recording 7 din tak available hoti hai.
- Monthly test har mahine ke aakhri Saturday ko.

Business: RentaRide (car rental, Islamabad)
- Cars: Suzuki Alto Rs 5,500/day, Toyota Corolla Rs 9,000/day, Toyota Fortuner Rs 25,000/day. Rates are with driver.
- Self-drive only for Alto and Corolla, needs CNIC, valid license and Rs 30,000 security deposit.
- Fuel is paid by the customer. Driver food and stay on outstation trips: Rs 2,000 per night.
- Minimum booking 12 hours.
- Cancellation free up to 24 hours before pickup; after that one day's rent is charged.
- Outstation trips to northern areas only in Fortuner and Corolla.
- Payment: cash or bank transfer, 25% advance to confirm.
